# CSE Success Plays Menu Site

This repository contains the hosted **Customer Success Engineer (CSE) Success Plays Menu** website styled according to the **Idira Dark Blueprint Theme**.

## Visual Specifications Applied
- **Background Color**: Dark Slate / Deep Navy (`#121820` / `#1E222A`)
- **Primary Text / Headers**: Off-White / Pale Silver (`#F0F2F5`)
- **Accent / Highlights**: Vivid Teal / Cyan (`#00D2C8`) & Amber Gold (`#E6A100`)
- **Card Containers**: Glassmorphism translucent cards (`rgba(255,255,255,0.06)`) with 1px border (`rgba(255,255,255,0.15)`)
- **Footer**: Single-line minimalist footer (8pt, 30% opacity) with confidentiality notice & page numbering.

## Deployment on GitHub Pages

1. **Create a GitHub Repository**:
   - Go to [GitHub](https://github.com/new) and create a new repository (e.g., `cse-success-plays`).

2. **Upload Files**:
   - Push these repository files:
     - `index.html`
     - `css/style.css`
     - `js/main.js`
     - `README.md`

3. **Enable GitHub Pages**:
   - Navigate to **Settings** > **Pages**.
   - Under **Build and deployment** > **Source**, choose **Deploy from a branch**.
   - Set Branch to `main` (or `master`) and folder to `/ (root)`.
   - Click **Save**.

Your website will be hosted live at `https://<your-username>.github.io/cse-success-plays/`.
